full_judgment: 4. Against this order the second party preferred Criminal Revision No.26 of 2004 before the Sessions Judge which was allowed and the 145 proceeding was dropped. Against the judgment the first party preferred Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7655 of 2004 under section 561 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and obtained rule and order of stay. The second party entered appearance and filed an application to vacate the order of stay. The High Court Division discharged the rule holding, inter-alia, that the second party as plaintiffs instituted the aforesaid title suit against the first party petitioners for declaration of title, confirmation of possession and partition and on application for temporary injunction and order of status-quo in respect of possession was passed. Ultimately the suit was decreed on contest on 8.7.2003 and as against that the first party preferred Title Appeal No. 63 of 2000 and prayed for stay of operation of the judgment and decree which was allowed by the. District Judge, subsequently the first party filed an application before the Magistrate, Barguna under section 144/145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for drawing up a proceeding and the Magistrate passed an order on 23.12.2003 drawing up a proceeding.
